rule.name: FieldCanBeFinal
rule.message: Field {0} is only assigned during initialization; declare it final.
rule.description: A private field written once in its declaration, in the one instance initializer or in each constructor (a static field in the one static initializer) and nowhere else can be final. A field read in a constructor or initializer of its class is left out too. Fields with an annotation other than @Deprecated or @SuppressWarnings, and classes of JPA entities or Lombok-generated members are left out, as frameworks and generated code write them.
